name: Sahuagin

skills.text: Handle Animal +1, Perception +6, Ride +6, Stealth +6, Survival +6, Swim +15

description: This scaly humanoid has a long, fish-like tail. Its arms and legs end in webbed claws, and its piscine head features a toothy maw.

ecology.name: Organisation
ecology.desc: Solitary, pair, team (5-8), patrol (11-20 plus 1 lieutenant of 3rd level and 1-2 sharks), band (20-80 plus 100% noncombatants, 1 lieutenant of 3rd level and 1 chieftain of 4th level per 20 adults, and 1-2 sharks), or tribe (70-160 plus 100% noncombatants, 1 lieutenant of 3rd level per 20 adults, 1 chieftain of 4th level per 40 adults, 9 guards of 4th level, 1-4 underpriestesses of 3rd-6th level, 1 priestess of 7th level, 1 baron of 6th-8th level, and 5-8 sharks)

ecology.name: Treasure
ecology.desc: NPC Gear (trident, heavy crossbow with 10 bolts, other treasure)
